y-m-62-02.title: Imisa labo-lab (a, b) ayaa ka dhigaya mid joogto ah?
y-m-62-02.topic: Joogtaynta iyo kala duwanaanshaha hawlaha la qeexay qaybo-qaybo
y-m-62-02.goal: Adigoo isticmaalaya tusaalayaal aad dhistay, xaqiiji in ay jiraan tiro aan dhammaad lahayn, ma aha hal oo keliya, oo labo-labooyinka isku-dhufashooyinka ka dhigaya hawl qaybo-qaybo ah mid joogto ah marka x=1, oo go'aami sida labo-labooyinka sidoo kale la kala duwan karo ay u kala duwan yihiin.
y-m-62-02.material: Joogtooyinka a iyo b, u qeex hawsha f sidan (x waa tiro dhab ah). Haddii x ka yar yahay 1, f(x)=x labajibaaran lagu daray a jeer x (x²+ax), haddii x ugu yaraan yahay 1 na, f(x)=2x+b. Hoos, a iyo b waa joogtooyin madax-banaan.
y-m-62-02.thinking.0: Barbar dhig tirada aan la aqoon iyo tirada shuruudaha

y-m-62-02.prereq.1: Shuruudda hawl ay joogto u tahay marka x=a (xadka bidix = xadka midig = qiimaha hawsha)
y-m-62-02.prereq.2: Kala duwanaanshaha hawlaha polynomial (x labajibaaran, odhaahyada toosan)
y-m-62-02.prereq.3: Macnaha derivative-ka (dhaadheerrada bidixda iyo midigta waa inay isle'eg yihiin si loo kala duwan karo)
y-m-62-02.s.s1.prompt: Imisa labo-lab (a, b) ayaa jira ee ka dhigaya f mid joogto ah marka x=1? Ka hor intaan xisaabaha la bilaabin, dooro xukunka ugu habboon.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.hint.0: Qor qiimayaasha aad hesho marka aad gelisid x=1 odhaahda bidix iyo odhaahda midig marka x=1.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tiri imisa isla'eg a iyo b ayuu shuruudda labada qiimood ay isle'eg yihiin bixiyaa.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.a: Hal labo-lab oo keliya ayaa jira, kaas oo a iyo b labaduba la go'aamiyay
y-m-62-02.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad u malaysay in maadaama ay jiraan laba aan la aqoon, qiimayaasha lagu go'aamiyay hal. Tiri imisa isla'eg ayay joogtayntu bixisaa.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.b: a iyo b waxaa lagu go'aamiyay laba labo-lab oo kala duwan
y-m-62-02.s.s1.r.b: Hubi halka aasaaska laba labo-lab ay ka yimaadeen. Eeg imisa isla'eg ayaa jira iyo heerkee.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.c: Odhaahdu muddo kasta way kala duwan tahay, sidaas darteed labo-lab ka dhigaya mid joogto ah ma jiro
y-m-62-02.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad u malaysay in maadaama odhaahdu muddo kasta kala duwan tahay, aan la isku xidhi karin. Si toos ah u barbar dhig qiimayaasha labada odhaah marka x=1.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.d: Hal isla'eg oo keliya ayaa jira, sidaas darteed doorashada a waxay go'aamisaa b
y-m-62-02.s.s1.explain: Si ay u noqoto joogto marka x=1, xadka bidix 1+a iyo qiimaha hawsha (xadka midig) 2+b waa inay isle'eg yihiin. Isla'egtan oo keliya ayaa jirta, sidaas darteed b=a−1, haddii aad si xor ah u dooratid a, b waa la go'aamiyay.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.prompt: Samee saddex labo-lab (a, b) oo kala duwan oo tirooyin dhan ah oo joogto ah marka x=1, halka qiimaha saxda ah ee a uu yahay ugu badnaan 4.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore dooro hal a oo hel qiimaha odhaahda bidix marka x=1.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hagaaji b si uu u le'eg yahay qiimaha odhaahda midig.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Xadka bidix 1+a iyo xadka midig (qiimaha hawsha) 2+b waa isle'eg yihiin.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Marka x=1, qiimaha odhaahda bidix 1+a iyo qiimaha odhaahda midig 2+b ma isle'ka.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Qiimaha saxda ah ee a waa ugu badnaan 4.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Qiimaha saxda ah ee a wuu ka weyn yahay 4.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.explain: Waa joogto haddii b=a−1 sax yahay. Tusaalayaal: (0, −1), (2, 1), (−3, −4). Haddii a isku mid yahay, b sidoo kale waa isku mid, sidaas darteed si loo tiriyo labo-labo kala duwan, a waa inay kala duwanaato.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.prompt: Labo-labooyinka aad hadda samaysay dhexdooda, dooro hadalka sax ah ee ku saabsan labo-labooyinka sidoo kale la kala duwan karo marka x=1. (Si loo kala duwan karo marka x=1, derivative-yada bidixda iyo midigta waa inay isle'eg yihiin.)
y-m-62-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kala duwan odhaahda dhinaca x ka yar 1 oo hel qiimaha marka x=1.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.hint.1: Hubi haddii ay jirto a ka dhigaysa isle'eg dhaadheerka odhaahda midig.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.o.a: Labo-labooyinka joogtada ah dhexdooda, labo-labada a=0, b=−1 oo keliya ayaa la kala duwan karaa
y-m-62-02.s.s3.o.b: Haddii ay joogto tahay waa la kala duwan karaa, sidaas darteed dhammaan labo-labooyinka aad samaysay waa ku habboon yihiin
y-m-62-02.s.s3.r.b: Waxaad u malaysay in joogto macnaheedu yahay la kala duwan karo. Si gooni ah u hel dhaadheerrada bidixda iyo midigta oo barbar dhig.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.o.c: Midna labo-labooyinka joogtada ah lama kala duwan karo
y-m-62-02.s.s3.r.c: Waxaad gaadhay gabagabo adigoo aan barbar dhigin dhaadheerrada. Arag haddii ay jirto a oo dhaadheerka bidixda 2+a iyo dhaadheerka midigta 2 ay isle'eg yihiin.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.o.d: Marka a weynaado, ayaa la sii kala duwan karaa
y-m-62-02.s.s3.r.d: Marka a weynaado, dhaadheerka bidixda 2+a sidoo kale wuu weynaadaa oo wuxuu ka fogaadaa midigta 2. Raadi qiimaha dhaadheerradu isle'eg yihiin.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.explain: Marka x=1, derivative-ka bidixda waa 2·1+a=2+a derivative-ka midigta na waa 2. Si ay isle'eg u noqdaan, a=0, shuruudda joogtaynta na, b=−1. Xitaa haddii ay joogto tahay, inta badan labo-labooyinka way foorarsadaan marka x=1, sidaas darteed lama kala duwan karo.

y-m-62-05.title: Imisa xariiq oo taabanaya ayaa laga sawiri karaa bar aan ku jirin curvaha?
y-m-62-05.topic: Xariiqyada taabanaya ee laga sawiro bar curvaha dibadda ah
y-m-62-05.goal: Xariiq taabanaya oo laga sawiray bar aan ku jirin curvaha, barta taabashada lama oga, sidaas darteed waa inaad u daweyso sida aan la aqoon oo aad dejiso shuruudo; ku xaqiiji tusaale aad naftaada dhistay in ay jiri karaan dhowr xariiq oo taabanaya.
y-m-62-05.material: Waxaa jira curve y=x² (x waa tiro dhab ah) iyo bar P(1, −3). Haddii isku-duubka x ee barta taabashadu yahay t, barta taabashadu waa (t, t²), jaleecada xariiqda taabanaysa halkaas na waa 2t, lagu helay geliinta x=t derivative-ka 2x ee y=x². Waxaan rabnaa inaan helno t ka dhigaya xariiqdan taabanaysa mid maraya barta P.
y-m-62-05.thinking.0: Kala saar doorarka barta taabashada iyo barta xariiqdu maraan

y-m-62-05.prereq.1: Xidhiidhka u dhexeeya derivative-ka iyo jaleecada xariiq taabanaysa
y-m-62-05.prereq.2: Isla'egta xariiq taabanaysa (barta (t, f(t)) ee curvaha, y−f(t)=f′(t)(x−t))
y-m-62-05.s.s1.prompt: Dooro habka saxda ah ee loo qori karo sida isla'eg shuruudda 'xariiqda taabanaysa barta taabashada (t, t²) waxay maraysaa barta P(1, −3)'.
y-m-62-05.s.s1.hint.0: Isla'egta xariiqda taabanaysa y−t²=2t(x−t), geli isku-duubyada barta P meelaha x iyo y.
y-m-62-05.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi haddii dhinaca bidix ee isla'egta aad gelisay uu yahay y−(isku-duubka y ee barta taabashada) dhinaca midig na uu yahay jaleeco×(x−isku-duubka x ee barta taabashada).
y-m-62-05.s.s1.r.a: Tani waa odhaah u daweysa P sida bar ku taal curvaha oo isticmaasha f(1)=1 meesha isku-duubka y. P ma aha barta taabashada.
y-m-62-05.s.s1.r.b: Hubi nidaamka x−t marka aad gelinayso x=1, y=−3 isla'egta xariiqda taabanaysa y−t²=2t(x−t).
y-m-62-05.s.s1.r.d: Tani waxay dejisaa jaleecada xariiqda taabanaysa 2. Jaleecadu waxay ku isbeddelaa booska t ee barta taabashada.
y-m-62-05.s.s1.explain: Isla'egta xariiqda taabanaysa waa y−t²=2t(x−t). Haddii ay maraysaa barta P(1, −3), geliinta x=1, y=−3 waxay siinaysaa −3−t²=2t(1−t).
y-m-62-05.s.s2.prompt: Samee laba xariiq oo taabanaya oo kala duwan oo marta barta P, mid kasta waxaa bixiya isku-duubka x t ee barta taabashadiisa iyo jaleecadiisa m.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.hint.0: Isla'egta c2, geli hal qiime t oo xisaabi haddii le'egnaanta run tahay.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.hint.1: Waxaad beddeli kartaa t oo barbar dhigi kartaa labada dhinac ee isla'egta, ama waxaad dib u habayn kartaa isla'egta sida isla'eg t ah oo xallin kartaa.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Jaleecadu waxay le'eg tahay derivative-ka 2t barta taabashada.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Jaleecada m way ka duwan tahay derivative-ka 2t barta taabashada.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.ok.c2: Xariiqdan taabanaysa waxay maraysaa barta P(1, −3).
y-m-62-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Xariiqdan taabanaysa ma marto barta P(1, −3). Hubi qiimaha y marka x=1.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.explain: Dib u habaynta −3−t²=2t(1−t) waxay siinaysaa t²−2t−3=0, taasi waa, (t−3)(t+1)=0, sidaas darteed t=3 ama t=−1. Waxaa jira laba xariiq oo taabanaya: jaleeco 6 (barta taabashada (3, 9)) iyo jaleeco −2 (barta taabashada (−1, 1)).
y-m-62-05.s.s3.prompt: Barbar dhig xariiqda taabanaysa ee lagu sawiray barta (1, 1) ee curvaha iyo xariiqyada taabanaya ee laga sawiray barta P(1, −3). Meeshee ayaa baraha taabashadu yihiin, imisa xariiq oo taabanaya ayaa kiis kasta jira, maxaa kala duwanaansho u keenay? Ku qor hal ama laba weedh.
y-m-62-05.s.s3.hint.0: Jaleecada (1, 1) waxaa lagu heli karaa geliinta x=1 derivative-ka y=x². Hubi haddii barta taasi ay ku taal curvaha.

y-m-62-06.s.s2.explain: x³−3x−2=(x−2)(x+1)², sidaas darteed f(x)>2 marka x>2 (marka x=−1 waa le'eg). Kala dhexaynta, 2<x≤3, marka x=3 na, f(3)=18. Sidaas darteed ugu badnaantu ma aha 2.
y-m-62-06.s.s3.prompt: Si aad u hesho ugu badnaanta iyo ugu yaraanta f kala dhexayntan, qor qiimayaasha baraha aad tahay inaad barbar dhigto, iyo sababta baraha kuwaas. Sidoo kale qor qiimayaasha musharraxiinta dhabta ah.
y-m-62-06.s.s3.hint.0: Xusuuso tusaalaha ka hortagga ee s2 ee ku saabsan halka f ugu weyn noqon karto −2 ≤ x ≤ 3.
y-m-62-06.s.s3.hint.1: Qor dhammaan musharraxiinta jadwal oo dhig qiimayaasha f dhinac kasta.
y-m-62-06.s.s3.placeholder: Tusaale: Barbar dhig qiimayaasha dhammaadyada kala dhexaynta iyo ... Sababtoo ah ...
y-m-62-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma qortay in musharraxiintu yihiin afarta bar (−2, −1, 1, 3)?
y-m-62-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma heshay qiimayaasha musharraxiinta −2, 2, −2, 18 naftaada oo ma barbar dhigtay?
y-m-62-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma ogaatay in ugu yaraanta −2 ay dhacdo laba meel (x=−2 iyo x=1)?
y-m-62-06.s.s3.model.0: Hel oo barbar dhig qiimayaasha labada dhammaad ee kala dhexaynta, x=−2 iyo x=3, iyo x=−1 iyo 1, halka f′(x)=0. f(−2)=−2, f(−1)=2, f(1)=−2, f(3)=18, sidaas darteed ugu badnaantu waa 18 ugu yaraantu na waa −2.
y-m-62-06.s.s3.model.1: Haddii aad eegto xadka-deegaanka oo keliya, qiimuhu wuu weynaan karaa dhammaadka kala dhexaynta, sidaas darteed taasi ma ku filna. Sidaas darteed waa inaad barbar dhigtaa qiimayaasha baraha xadka-deegaanka iyo labada dhammaad x=−2 iyo x=3, qiimaha ugu weyn 18 waa ugu badnaanta qiimaha ugu yar −2 na waa ugu yaraanta. Ugu yaraantu waxay dhacdaa laba meel, x=−2 iyo x=1.

y-m-62-07.prereq.0: Malo-awaalka kala horreynta dugsiga: H2 ee hawshan waa heer adag oo qaabka soo saarista oo keliya macnaheeduna maaha in loo qoondeeyay sannad dugsi kasta. Waxaa loogu talagalay ardayda horay u barateen shuruudaha hore ee hoose.
y-m-62-07.title: Maxaa dhaca haddii hooseeyuhu u dhowaado 0 laakiin xadku jiro?
y-m-62-07.topic: Xadka jajabyada hooseeyahoodu noqdo 0, iyo isku-dhufashooyinka aan la go'aamin
y-m-62-07.goal: Adigoo isticmaalaya shuruudda lagama maarmaanka ah ee ah haddii xadka jajab hooseeyihiisu u socdo 0 uu jiro sida qiime xad leh markaas koreeyuhu sidoo kale u socdo 0, ku xaqiiji in marka shuruudaha aysan ku filnayn jawaabtu tahay lammaaneyaal badan, marka shuruud lagu daro na lagu go'aamiyo hal.
y-m-62-07.material: Joogtooyin a iyo b, tixgeli xadka jajabka (x²+ax+b)/(x−2) marka x u socdo 2. Hooseeyaha x−2 wuxuu u dhowaadaa 0 marka x u dhowaado 2. Hadda, waxa aan ogsoonahay oo keliya waa in xadka jajabkan uu jiro sida qiime dhab ah qaar.
y-m-62-07.thinking.1: Dhis dhowr xal xaalad shuruudaha aysan ku filnayn
y-m-62-07.thinking.2: Sharax hannaanka shuruud lagu daray ay xalka ku go'aamiso
y-m-62-07.prereq.1: Macnaha xadka shaqo iyo xisaabinta qiimayaasha xadka
y-m-62-07.prereq.2: Xadka kiisaska qodobayn iyo tirtirid suurtagal tahay
y-m-62-07.prereq.3: Waxa xalalku u egyihiin marka hal isla'eg uu jiro laba aan la aqoon
y-m-62-07.s.s1.prompt: Marka waxa aan ogsoonahay oo keliya yahay shuruudda ah xadku wuxuu jiraa sida qiime dhab ah, kee ayaa ah bayaanka ugu habboon ee ku saabsan a iyo b?
y-m-62-07.s.s1.hint.0: Fiiri waxa dhaca cabbirka jajabka haddii qiimaha koreeyuhu u dhowaado lambar aan eber ahayn marka x u dhowaado 2.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.hint.1: Barbar dhig farqiga u dhexeeya kiiska qiimaha koreeyuhu u socdo lambar aan eber ahayn iyo kiiska u socdo 0.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.o.a: Hooseeyuhu wuxuu u dhowaadaa 0, sidaas darteed xad ma jiri karo a, b kasta
y-m-62-07.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad u maleysay marka hooseeyuhu u dhowaado 0 mar walba wuu kala fogaadaa. Hubi haddii koreeyuhu sidoo kale u dhowaado 0, ma jiraan kiisas tirtirid suurtagal tahay.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.o.b: Xad wuu jiraa marka a iyo b labaduba yihiin 0 oo keliya
y-m-62-07.s.s1.r.b: Haddii a=b=0, wuxuu noqdaa x²/(x−2) xadku na ma jiro. Geli oo eeg si toos ah.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.o.c: Korreeyuhu waa inuu noqdaa 0 marka x=2, sidaa darteed b waxaa go'aamiya a, a na waa xor
y-m-62-07.s.s1.o.d: Labada a iyo b waxaa lagu go'aamiyey qiime keliya
y-m-62-07.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad u malaysay in labada aan la aqoon la go'aamiyey. Tiri imisa isla'eg ayay shuruudda ah in xadku jiro siinayso.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.explain: Haddii hoosaadku u socdo 0 xadkuna yahay mid xaddidan, korreeyuhuna waa inuu u socdaa 0. Qiimaha korreeyaha marka x=2, 4+2a+b, waa inuu noqdaa 0, sidaa darteed b=−4−2a. Waxaa jirta isla'egtan keliya, sidaa darteed a waa xor.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.prompt: Samee saddex lammaane oo kala duwan (a, b) oo xadku jiro oo qiimaha xadku ka weyn yahay 0.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore dooro hal a oo hagaaji b si korreeyuhu u noqdo 0 marka x=2.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.hint.1: Jajabkaas yaree oo hubi in qiimaha tibaaxda haray x=2 uu ka weyn yahay 0.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Korreeyuhu waa 0 marka x=2 (qiimaha korreeyaha x=2, 4+2a+b, waa 0).
y-m-62-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Korreeyuhu ma aha 0 marka x=2, sidaa darteed xadku ma jiro. Hubi qiimaha 4+2a+b.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Qiimaha xadka (a+4) wuu ka weyn yahay 0.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Qiimaha xadku ka weyn maaha 0. Hubi qiimaha x=2 ee tibaaxda haray x+2+a ka dib yaraynta.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.explain: Haddii b=−4−2a, korreeyaha x²+ax+b=(x−2)(x+2+a), sidaa darteed ka dib yaraynta qiimaha xadku waa 4+a. Si qiimahani uga weynaado 0, a>−4. Tusaalayaal: (1, −6) wuxuu leeyahay qiimaha xadka 5, (0, −4) wuxuu leeyahay qiimaha xadka 4, (3, −10) wuxuu leeyahay qiimaha xadka 7.
y-m-62-07.s.s3.prompt: U qaado macluumaadka ah in qiimaha xadku yahay 5 la ku daray. Qor waxa (a, b) noqoto, oo sharax sababta aan bilowgii hal loogu go'aamin laakiin hadda la go'aamiyey.
y-m-62-07.s.s3.hint.0: Mar kale eeg sharaxaadda s2 sida qiimaha x=2 ee tibaaxda haray ka dib yaraynta uu ugu xidhan yahay qiimaha xadka.
y-m-62-07.s.s3.hint.1: Ka fikir imisa shuruudood ayaa loo baahan yahay si labada aan la aqoon loo go'aamiyo.
y-m-62-07.s.s3.placeholder: Tusaale: Haddii qiimaha xadku yahay 5, markaas ... sidaa darteed (a, b)=...
y-m-62-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma qortay in qiimaha xadka 5 uu siinayo isla'egta 'qiimaha a+4 ka dib yaraynta iyo gelinta x=2 waa 5'?
y-m-62-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma si gooni ah u qortay isla'egta ay siinayso shuruudda koowaad iyo isla'egta ay siinayso shuruudda cusub?
y-m-62-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma hubisay qiimaha b=−6 shuruudda ah in korreeyuhu yahay 0 marka x=2?
y-m-62-07.s.s3.model.0: Haddii qiimaha xadku yahay 5, markaas a+4=5, sidaa darteed a=1, korreeyuhuna waa inuu noqdaa 0, sidaa darteed 4+2+b=0 iyo b=−6. Bilowgii waxaa jirtay hal isla'eg, sidaa darteed a waa xor, laakiin hadda waxaa jira laba isla'eg, sidaa darteed labada aan la aqoon waa la go'aamiyey.
y-m-62-07.s.s3.model.1: (a, b)=(1, −6). Shuruudda ah in xadku jiro waxay siinaysaa hal isla'eg oo keliya, qiimaha xadku inuu yahay 5 na wuxuu siinayaa hal isla'eg oo kale, a+4=5, sidaa darteed hadda waxaa jira laba shuruudood waxaana lagu go'aamiyey hal.
